title: OP script Unlock Camera Shelves Teleport more
features:
Clean The Library 📖

🌟 FEATURES:

• 🎥 Unlock Camera : The camera becomes completely free, your mouse cursor roams freely on the screen, and you can easily click all buttons! (Hold Right Mouse Button to look around).

• ⚡ Enhanced WalkSpeed (100): Move across the map at lightning speed!

• 📚 Book Category ESP: See all book categories (Studio, Simulators, Myths, Horror, Economy, etc.) through walls with lines (Beams) and glows (Highlights)!

• 🌀 Shelves Teleport (Floor 1 & Floor 2): Instantly teleport to any book shelf from 1A to 2F with a single click!

• 🧹 Reset ESP: Clear all active ESP markers with a single click.

📌 Note: After entering the key, your mouse will be completely unlocked and visible!
